name: 現在地ピル付き上部ツールナビゲーション
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0020 現在地ピル付き上部ツールナビゲーション.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact five-part top navigation row, original region18,72,354,40 normalized. Left small circular account avatar with authored Japanese 灯 (Regular14/24) and original small red notification DOT at upper-right, no numeral. Then selected elongated pill containing ORIGINAL solid house glyph and exact label ホーム (Meiryo Bold14/24,tracking0). Then THREE equal small rounded/circular utility buttons: ORIGINAL rounded speech bubble outline, ORIGINAL small calendar grid (top horizontal header band and compact date dots, not mock binder-ring calendar), ORIGINAL inbox TRAY with folded upper corners and central inset, NOT mock envelope. Source fine glyph anatomy, optical weight/proportions and alignment govern all controls. Adapt selected Home pill to forest-green smooth gradient with WHITE solid house and white label; unselected utility buttons and avatar are white with fine neutral outlines/soft minimal shadows and slate#526173 glyphs/initial. Preserve red notification dot#B8473E as actual state. Remove all mint fills. Keep single horizontal row with compact source40px logical height and354px logical width; uniformly enlarge into readable wide1536x512 composition with restrained pure-white margins. No extra enclosing card, source scrim/phone chrome, notification badges withnumbers, labels onutilityicons or additional navigation controls.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Retain red notification dot. Adapt selected Home pill to forest-green gradient/whiteglyph+label; unselected utilities/identity remain slate on white, no decorative mint.

reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
